# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

[ Contact a Ryder Expert ][218] [ Explore Ryder Port2Door™ ][219]

carrier management, financial settlement, and real-time visibility to help you control costs,
improve service, and adapt quickly.

## Managed Transportation You Can Rely On

Our Transportation Management solution combines disciplined carrier qualification, operational
oversight, AI-driven monitoring, and one of the largest transportation networks in North America to
help you move freight with greater confidence, reliability, and control.

Carrier selection matters more than ever. Ryder applies disciplined qualification standards and
ongoing oversight to help you secure reliable capacity from carriers to meet rigorous operational
and safety expectations.

# Technology-Driven Supply Chain Solutions Built Around Your Business

Today's supply chains require more than disconnected services. Powered by proprietary digital
platforms, AI-enabled intelligence, automation, and the expertise of our people, Ryder helps you
navigate complexity with greater visibility, control, and confidence. From fleet leasing and
maintenance to dedicated transportation, transportation management, freight brokerage, warehouse
management, contract packaging and manufacturing, e-commerce and omnichannel fulfillment, and
last-mile delivery, we deliver connected port-to-door solutions designed to keep your supply chain
moving and your business ahead.

[ Contact a Ryder Expert ][218] [ Explore Ryder Port2Door™ ][219]
[Ryder warehouse associate scanning a package beside automated warehouse robots]
Ryder Port2Door™ Solutions

you can maximize the flexibility, efficiency, and sustainability of your supply chain.

carrier management, financial settlement, and real-time visibility to help you control costs,
improve service, and adapt quickly.

## Managed Transportation You Can Rely On

Our Transportation Management solution combines disciplined carrier qualification, operational
oversight, AI-driven monitoring, and one of the largest transportation networks in North America to
help you move freight with greater confidence, reliability, and control.

[Explore Transportation Management ][240]

## Expert Carrier Vetting

Carrier selection matters more than ever. Ryder applies disciplined qualification standards and
ongoing oversight to help you secure reliable capacity from carriers to meet rigorous operational
and safety expectations.

# The Pill that
# moves the needle^{®}

## About Vaxart

Vaxart is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a range of oral recombinant pill
vaccines based on our innovative delivery platform.

We have proprietary technology, partnerships to accelerate our development, and an experienced team
with deep industry expertise.

## Our Mission

### Breaking News

#### [Nasal DNA Vaccine Protects Against Tuberculosis][296]
* July, 2026

Researchers have developed an experimental therapeutic nasal DNA vaccine for tuberculosis.

#### [New HIV Vaccine Could Protect Against Development of HIV Infection and AIDS][297]
* July, 2026

Scientists have developed a new HIV vaccine that has the potential to protect humans from developing
HIV infection and AIDS.

#### [BCG Vaccine Linked to Changes in Brain Immunity and Alzheimer’s Biomarkers][298]
* July, 2026

The Bacillus Calmette-Guérin accine may alter immune activity around the brain and change levels of
a protein closely associated with Alzheimer’s disease in older adults without evidence of the
condition.

#### [First Treg Immunotherapy Approved to Improve Chronic GVHD-Free Survival in Blood Cancer
#### Patients][299]
* July, 2026

FDA has approved Tregzi, the first regulatory T (Treg) cell-based immunotherapy for improving
chronic graft-versus-host disease (GVHD)-free survival in adult patients with blood cancers
undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

#### [FDA Approves Veligrotug-vvze (Lumvoa) for Thyroid Eye Disease][300]
* June, 2026

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved veligrotug-vvze (Lumvoa; Viridian Therapeutics)
to treat thyroid eye disease.

#### [FDA Approves Moderna’s mRNA Influenza Vaccine][301]
* June, 2026

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s accines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee
voted to recommend approval of the Moderna’s investigational mRNA influenza vaccine, which will be
marketed under the brand name mFlusiva, for the prevention of flu in adults age 50 to 64.

### Breaking News

#### [Nasal DNA Vaccine Protects Against Tuberculosis][296]
* July, 2026

Researchers have developed an experimental therapeutic nasal DNA vaccine for tuberculosis.

#### [New HIV Vaccine Could Protect Against Development of HIV Infection and AIDS][297]
* July, 2026

Scientists have developed a new HIV vaccine that has the potential to protect humans from developing
HIV infection and AIDS.

#### [BCG Vaccine Linked to Changes in Brain Immunity and Alzheimer’s Biomarkers][298]
* July, 2026

The Bacillus Calmette-Guérin accine may alter immune activity around the brain and change levels of
a protein closely associated with Alzheimer’s disease in older adults without evidence of the
condition.

#### [First Treg Immunotherapy Approved to Improve Chronic GVHD-Free Survival in Blood Cancer
#### Patients][299]
* July, 2026

FDA has approved Tregzi, the first regulatory T (Treg) cell-based immunotherapy for improving
chronic graft-versus-host disease (GVHD)-free survival in adult patients with blood cancers
undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.

#### [FDA Approves Veligrotug-vvze (Lumvoa) for Thyroid Eye Disease][300]
* June, 2026

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved veligrotug-vvze (Lumvoa; Viridian Therapeutics)
to treat thyroid eye disease.

#### [FDA Approves Moderna’s mRNA Influenza Vaccine][301]
* June, 2026

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s accines and Related Biological Products Advisory Committee
voted to recommend approval of the Moderna’s investigational mRNA influenza vaccine, which will be
marketed under the brand name mFlusiva, for the prevention of flu in adults age 50 to 64.

# Welcome to CSL Seqirus U.S. Click below to learn more about our company.

[Our Company][58]

## We're committed to the fight against influenza

At CSL Seqirus, we are driven by just one goal - to lessen the severity and impact of influenza,
which can reach epidemic or even pandemic proportions with life-threatening consequences. Every year
our influenza vaccines help protect millions of people. We find solutions to big, complex,
challenging problems, and we see the results in the world around us. Then we do it all over again
the following year.

CSL Seqirus is one of the world’s largest influenza vaccine companies. We were created when our
parent company, CSL Limited, acquired the Novartis influenza vaccine business and combined its
vaccine subsidiary, bioCSL.

## 100 years of securing healthy lives

CSL Seqirus has a rich heritage in the fight against influenza. As part of CSL, our experience dates
back to the deadly 1918 influenza pandemic and we’ve worked with global health partners on the front
line of influenza protection ever since.

[Learn more][59]

## Join us on the front line

When you join CSL Seqirus, you join a skilled and passionate team dedicated to protecting people and
communities from influenza. It's the feeling of purpose and possibility that inspires us every day.

[Careers][60]

# Welcome to CSL Seqirus U.S. Click below to learn more about our company.

[Our Company][58]

## We're committed to the fight against influenza

At CSL Seqirus, we are driven by just one goal - to lessen the severity and impact of influenza,
which can reach epidemic or even pandemic proportions with life-threatening consequences. Every year
our influenza vaccines help protect millions of people. We find solutions to big, complex,
challenging problems, and we see the results in the world around us. Then we do it all over again
the following year.

CSL Seqirus is one of the world’s largest influenza vaccine companies. We were created when our
parent company, CSL Limited, acquired the Novartis influenza vaccine business and combined its
vaccine subsidiary, bioCSL.

## 100 years of securing healthy lives

CSL Seqirus has a rich heritage in the fight against influenza. As part of CSL, our experience dates
back to the deadly 1918 influenza pandemic and we’ve worked with global health partners on the front
line of influenza protection ever since.

[Learn more][59]

## Join us on the front line

When you join CSL Seqirus, you join a skilled and passionate team dedicated to protecting people and
communities from influenza. It's the feeling of purpose and possibility that inspires us every day.

[Careers][60]

# e7 Health

[Vaccine Services]

## We are now e7 Health!

Why e7 Health? Due to our success and growth, we wanted a name that would more adequately represent
the 7 areas of health care (Travel Medicine, Student Health, Corporate Health Services, Drug
Testing, STD Testing, Physicals and Labs, and Vaccines) offerings we provide and to highlight
advanced technology that we are using to integrate all 7 areas of health care.

## A Preventative Health and Wellness Company

e7 Health is a preventative health and wellness company that is supervised by Board Certified
Doctors. We offer same day and next day appointments and allow you to book your appointments online!
We specialize in travel medicine, student health, employee health, drug testing, STD testing,
physical exams, immigration exams, and laboratory services. We are committed to providing the safest
and highest quality care to our patients and clients. We are proud of the highly qualified and
dedicated professional staff at e7 Health for their commitment to providing a positive and
comfortable clinic for our patients. We strive every day to ensure that all of our patients are
satisfied and well taken care of. We look forward to serving you!

the 7 areas of health care (Travel Medicine, Student Health, Corporate Health Services, Drug
Testing, STD Testing, Physicals and Labs, and Vaccines) offerings we provide and to highlight
advanced technology that we are using to integrate all 7 areas of health care.

## A Preventative Health and Wellness Company

e7 Health is a preventative health and wellness company that is supervised by Board Certified
Doctors. We offer same day and next day appointments and allow you to book your appointments online!

dedicated professional staff at e7 Health for their commitment to providing a positive and
comfortable clinic for our patients. We strive every day to ensure that all of our patients are
satisfied and well taken care of. We look forward to serving you!

## Welcome to NAIIS Online!


# Welcome to the National Adult and Influenza Immunization Summit (NAIIS)

The NAIIS is dedicated to addressing and resolving adult and influenza immunization issues and
improving vaccines for use in the United States. The NAIIS consists of over 700 partners,
representing more than 130 public and private organizations. Broad-based leadership of the NAIIS is
conducted through the members of the Summit Organizing Committee (SOC).

[LEARN MORE][38]   [JOIN THE SUMMIT][39]

 

# A Call to Action to Protect All Adults from Vaccine-Preventable Disease and Disability

Vaccinations are critical components of routine healthcare for adults, yet at least 3 out of every 4
adults are missing one or more routinely recommended vaccines. Given the enormous health benefits of
adult vaccinations and low rates of adult vaccination made worse by the COVID-19 pandemic, the
National Adult and Influenza Immunization Summit (NAIIS) members call on providers across the
healthcare spectrum to take actions to improve routine vaccination of adults. Read more about the
[Call to Action for Adult Immunizations][40] and consider adding your organization to those taking
action to improve adult vaccination rates.

### FEATURED RESOURCES

[2024 Strategies to Address Policy Barriers to Adult Immunizations in Federally Qualified Health
Centers][41]

White paper outlining policy barriers and strategies to increase adult immunization rates in FQHCs.

[Assessing the Strength of Scientific Evidence for Clinical Guidance: A Practical Guide for
Healthcare Professionals][42][[patient-intake-form]][43]

Clinical guidance must be based on the rigorous evaluation of scientific evidence. This document
offers a concise overview to help healthcare professionals recognize systematic, evidence-based
processes.

[Tip Sheet on Adult Vaccine Recommendations and Implementation Resources][44]

Tips to help providers get adult patients back on track with their immunizations.

 

[Quick Guide to Adult Vaccine Messaging][45]

Tips for sharing important vaccine messages with adults.

## Welcome to NAIIS Online!


# Welcome to the National Adult and Influenza Immunization Summit (NAIIS)

The NAIIS is dedicated to addressing and resolving adult and influenza immunization issues and
improving vaccines for use in the United States. The NAIIS consists of over 700 partners,
representing more than 130 public and private organizations. Broad-based leadership of the NAIIS is
conducted through the members of the Summit Organizing Committee (SOC).

[LEARN MORE][38]   [JOIN THE SUMMIT][39]

 

# A Call to Action to Protect All Adults from Vaccine-Preventable Disease and Disability

Vaccinations are critical components of routine healthcare for adults, yet at least 3 out of every 4
adults are missing one or more routinely recommended vaccines. Given the enormous health benefits of
adult vaccinations and low rates of adult vaccination made worse by the COVID-19 pandemic, the
National Adult and Influenza Immunization Summit (NAIIS) members call on providers across the
healthcare spectrum to take actions to improve routine vaccination of adults. Read more about the
[Call to Action for Adult Immunizations][40] and consider adding your organization to those taking
action to improve adult vaccination rates.

### FEATURED RESOURCES

[2024 Strategies to Address Policy Barriers to Adult Immunizations in Federally Qualified Health
Centers][41]

White paper outlining policy barriers and strategies to increase adult immunization rates in FQHCs.

[Assessing the Strength of Scientific Evidence for Clinical Guidance: A Practical Guide for
Healthcare Professionals][42][[patient-intake-form]][43]

Clinical guidance must be based on the rigorous evaluation of scientific evidence. This document
offers a concise overview to help healthcare professionals recognize systematic, evidence-based
processes.

[Tip Sheet on Adult Vaccine Recommendations and Implementation Resources][44]

Tips to help providers get adult patients back on track with their immunizations.

 

[Quick Guide to Adult Vaccine Messaging][45]

Tips for sharing important vaccine messages with adults.


[July 9, 2026][46]
* American College Health Association (ACHA) Vaccination Initiatives
* Back-to-School Presentation: Meeting Students at Move-In
* Announcements
[Read More][47]

### SAVRR Council

The SAVRR Council provides independent, non-binding guidance to the Summit and its partners on the
implementation of U.S. adult and influenza immunization recommendations.

Meeting registration, members list, resources, and meeting archives are available

[More Information][48]

The NAIIS seeks to better understand providers’ vaccine billing challenges. Click below for more
information about reporting challenges.

## About Wallenius Wilhelmsen

The Wallenius Wilhelmsen group is a market leader in roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) shipping and vehicle
logistics, managing the distribution of cars, trucks, rolling equipment and breakbulk to customers
all over the world.

The company operates around 125 vessels servicing 15 trade routes to six continents, a global inland
distribution network, 66 processing centers and seven marine terminals.

With the head office in Oslo, Norway, the Wallenius Wilhelmsen group has 9500 employees in 28
countries worldwide.

### About the Weston A. Price Foundation

**The Weston A. Price Foundation (WAPF) is your source for accurate information on nutrition and
health, always aiming to provide the scientific validation of traditional foodways. People seeking
health today often condemn certain food groups — such as grains, dairy foods, meat, salt, fat,
sauces, sweets and nightshade vegetables — but the Wise Traditions Diet is inclusive, not
exclusive.**

We show you how to include all these nourishing traditional foods in your diet through wise choices
and proper preparation techniques. The result is vibrant health for every age of life, including the
next generation. [Read more. . .][75]
